notes: Build84 clean runtime starts from stable Build82. Shipped surface is allowlisted to the canonical launcher, event-driven runtime client, clean account controller and minimal runtime bus only. License activation, protocol-based Trust, GitHub, Supabase and on-demand project state are reattached without the legacy DOM stack. Reattached modules now render their functional surfaces inside the single launcher Shadow DOM. OAuth is only initiated by an explicit Connect click, preventing connected modules from leaving blank tabs. Supabase project discovery combines direct /projects with organization-scoped project listing in the backend. No legacy ui/content stack, mount guardian, global MutationObserver, continuous polling, heavy provider engine, OTA metadata or release publication is shipped.
